posts.title: Dynamic Consistency Boundaries — the Chronicle way
posts.description: What is a Dynamic Consistency Boundary? A Dynamic Consistency Boundary (DCB) is a deceptively simple idea: consistency should be scoped to the facts a decision actually needs, not to a fixed object boundary drawn at design time.
